summary: Vérifier la couverture et les budgets existants R6 R7 R12 sur captures HTTP et sur les 10 derniers reçus de déploiement du S24.
reason: Les routes et la garde owner existent déjà ; conserver leur preuve sans créer de route, budget copié ou mutateur.

tests.name: Existing R6 HTTP owner contract and build
tests.evidence: npm run build and test-agent-config.cjs passed; existing owner refusal, scoped patch, receipts, idempotence and bank refusal remain unchanged.

capabilities.reason: No runtime route, action or exposed information added.

architecture.reason: Only CI evidence; no runtime persistence, scheduler, daemon or router.

mcp_owner_parity.reason: The test imports acceptance policy and reads tracked sanitized captures only; no route, schema, adapter or primitive behavior changes.

rollback: Revert the H5 evidence test and its CI step.
